As per Government circular no FD 355 EXP-12/2024 dtd01.08.2024, Letter of Intent (LoI) will be issued in Karnataka Public Procurement Portal 2.0 software, contractor has to accept LOI online and submit the BGs through KPP portal within 20 days. if not, tender will be rejected as per Guidelines.
All precautions should be taken by the contractor so that there are no damages to such public/ private properties
The intending contractors are requested to note that they should abide by the detailed instructions and conditions contained in the Standard Tender documents K/C-7

The Assignment of preparation of DPR and including Structural design drawings shall be completed within 30 DAYS from the date of Agreement and the Assignment / Any variations, agreement continues till the physical completion of the proposed work.
The consultancy has to co-ordinate with the Department / contractor during the execution of the work
The consultancy has to prepare structural designs including structural drawings.

To visit the site prepare the layout drawing along with building plan & elevation., To prepare the structural design drawings along with service drawings based on the site conditions & considering the SBC of the soil, Visit to the site as and when client desires, to visit the site for guiding the client during the execution of work.
The Department will not provide any office infrastructure and services facility to the consultant, The SBC of the soil has to be tested by Department for the design of the structure

In case the given time schedule for submissions is not adhered to by the consultant, a maximum of 7 days grace period shall be allowed, after which a penalty of 0.1% of the consultancy fee per day will be levied. The penalty amount shall be deducted from the fees, The maximum penalty shall not exceed 10% of consultancy fee, The services of the consultant shall be terminated if total penalty exceeds the maximum penalty.

To qualify for this tender the bidder has to attend the Pre bid meeting to be held at PWD DIVISION OFFICE HOSAPETE and obtain the certificate of qualification to bid for the tender and Upload the Same in KPPP

Tenderer shall obtain the Work experience certificate/consultancy workdone certificate in the prescribed format from the Competent Authority not below the rank of Executive Engineer( District Level Officer), scan the original Certificate and attach the scanned file to the tender. The Original Certificate shall be produced at the time of opening of Technical Bids for physical verification

To qualify for award of this contract, the Consultant in its name should have in the last five years i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24 2024-25. & 2025-26 Achieved in at least two financial years a minimum financial turnover of Rs.2.70 Lakhs from Consultancy Services which are Civil in Nature

The Consultants Should have experience in Preparation of DPR and Structural design of Building work costing minimum Rs 5.40 crores within previous five years i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23 ,2023-24 2024-25 & 2025-26
TheAgency Preparing the DPR is held responsible for any changes in the DPR in upcoming days. No extra fund provision will be made for any changes in the DPR.
The Tenderer while preparing the DPR, Should Consult with AEE/AE/JE of Respective PWD Subdivison and Visit the site and Prepare the DPR according to required site condition.
